title: ParleyPacket
description: Structured conflict escalation packet containing contradictory claims, minimal unsatisfiable cores, consequences, and designated human decision authorities.

packetId.description: Unique identifier for this parley escalation packet.

incidentId.description: Identifier tying this contradiction incident to cross-project review and audit records.

ladderLevel.description: Contradiction Ladder level where conflict was trapped: 0 (schema), 1 (exact constraint), 2 (program contract), 3 (candidate semantic), 4 (human parley).

conflictingClaimIds.description: Identifiers of the mutually incompatible claim envelopes.

unsatisfiableCore.description: Minimal subset of claims/assumptions that cannot simultaneously hold true.

consequenceMatrix.description: Exploration of alternatives: consequences and trade-offs of adopting each conflicting claim or rejecting all.

authorizedDecisionMakers.description: Human principal IDs with governance authority to resolve this policy/semantic conflict.

quiescentState.description: Instructions for safe pause: which dependent tasks must wait, and which independent tasks may continue.

resolution.description: Record of human decision settlement once parley concludes.
